manual.title: Manual Credentials / Token
manual.description: Enter your phone number and PIN or a manual session token copied from your browser.

addon.title: Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on
addon.description: Connect via the Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on to keep sessions alive automatically. Please ensure the Trade Republic Add-on is installed, running and accessible (default container host: edfe50eb_traderepublic / 127.0.0.1, port 8095).

addon_confirm.title: Trade Republic Add-on Found
addon_confirm.description: An active Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on was found ({host}). Would you like to connect to it to automatically manage your session?

addon_scan.title: Trade Republic Login
addon_scan.description:
Enter your phone number & PIN below (Recommended — sends a 1-tap push notification to your Trade Republic app).

Alternatively, leave PIN empty and click Submit to use QR code login.

addon_qr.title: Trade Republic QR Code Login
addon_qr.description:
Scan the QR code with your smartphone camera, approve the login in the Trade Republic app, then click Submit.

*Note: The Trade Republic app has no in-app QR scanner; use your phone's camera app.*

![QR Code]({qr_image})

addon_login.title: Login via Trade Republic Add-on
addon_login.description: Enter your credentials. The Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on handles authentication and keeps the session active.

addon_2fa.title: Confirm Login on Smartphone
addon_2fa.description: A login prompt was sent to your Trade Republic smartphone app. Please open the app on your phone and approve the request, or enter the 4-digit push code if you received a notification.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Please enter the verification code sent to your phone or app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Trade Republic
reauth_confirm.description:
Your session has expired.

✅ **Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on detected** at `{addon_host}:{addon_port}` with an active session.

Choose how you would like to renew your session:

reauth_confirm_no_session.title: Re-authenticate Trade Republic
reauth_confirm_no_session.description:
Your session has expired.

✅ **Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on is running** at `{addon_host}:{addon_port}`, but no active session is logged in yet.

Choose how you would like to re-authenticate:

reauth_confirm_offline.title: Re-authenticate Trade Republic
reauth_confirm_offline.description:
Your session has expired.

⚠️ **Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on unreachable** at `{addon_host}:{addon_port}`. Please ensure the Add-on is started.

Choose how you would like to renew your session:

reauth_ingress.title: Trade Republic Add-on Web UI
reauth_ingress.description:
Open the Trade Republic Add-on Web UI using the link below, log in there, then return here and click Submit.

👉 [Open Trade Republic Add-on Web UI]({ingress_url})

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Trade Republic servers.
error.cannot_connect_addon: Could not connect to the Trade Republic Home Assistant Add-on. Please ensure the Add-on is started and host/port are reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your phone number and PIN.
error.invalid_pin: PIN must be between 4 and 6 digits (numbers only)
error.invalid_phone: Please provide a valid international phone number (e.g. +491701234567)
error.addon_no_session: No active session found in the Trade Republic Add-on. Please log in via the Add-on Web UI or scan the QR code.
error.addon_api_error: Trade Republic rejected the login request (MISSING_REQUIRED_HEADER or WAF token error). This is an Add-on issue — please check Add-on logs, restart the Add-on, or wait for an Add-on update.
error.addon_api_outdated: Trade Republic has disabled the v1 login API (returned 426 CLIENT_VERSION_OUTDATED). The Add-on must be updated to support the current v2 push-approval login. Please update the Trade Republic Add-on.
error.timeout_expired: The login challenge timed out (2 minutes exceeded). Click Submit to send a new login request to your Trade Republic smartphone app.
error.approval_pending: Login not yet confirmed. Please open your Trade Republic smartphone app and approve the login prompt, then click Submit again.
error.qr_not_confirmed: The QR code has not yet been approved in your Trade Republic smartphone app or has expired. Please re-scan the QR code and click Submit.

init.title: Trade Republic Options
init.description: Adjust update interval, interest rate, or trigger an instant re-authentication directly within Home Assistant.

reauth_required.title: Trade Republic Re-authentication Required
reauth_required.description: Your Trade Republic session has expired. Please re-authenticate your integration.
